desc: Model each state as (vertex, reversal-parity), with movement preserving parity and reversal toggling parity.
Use original adjacency in parity 0 and reversed adjacency in parity 1.
Represent reversal at every vertex as a transition of cost \(X\).
Implement Dijkstra with fast stdin parsing, stale-entry checks, and 64-bit integer distances.
Verify \(O((N+M)\log N)\) time and \(O(N+M)\) memory and produce the required delimited code.
